question: Which among the following was set up in 1956 by Indian government by nationalising all the existing private sector life insurance companies?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Life Insurance Corporation of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Life Insurance Corporation (LIC) :
 
• It is owned by the Indian government, and the Ministry of Finance is in charge of its administration.
 
• It is a statutory body.
 
• On September 1, 1956, the Life Insurance of India Act, which nationalised the insurance sector in India, was approved by the Indian Parliament, creating the Life Insurance Corporation of India. 
 
• It is the biggest institutional investment and insurance company in India.
 
• LIC provides life insurance and pension products to individuals.
